US Ambassador Highlights India-US Cooperation in Kolkata

US Ambassador to India, Sergio Gor, stated that India and the United States are expanding cooperation across various sectors. He made these remarks during a visit to Kolkata, where he also visited Durga Puja pandals, noting the strong relationship between the two nations.
